scripts.verify: pnpm -r run lint && pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run test && cargo test --manifest-path crates/tools-runner/Cargo.toml
scripts.package:desktop: corepack pnpm --filter @ai-hub/hub build && cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/tools-runner/Cargo.toml && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-hub/desktop tauri:build
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm verify && pnpm package:desktop && pnpm release:manifest
